text: OPERATOR NOTE (GM-confirmed facts, weigh them): batch-*-style = topology|wrapper|expansion. The solver's TOPOLOGY and WRAPPER parts are already right; the bug is the 3rd part (variable-expansion form) -- solve.py emits "percent" for every batch file. GM-accepted on TT b10c4da4: 34c1d9=single|if_guard|call_double, 1fc58f=diamond|errorlevel_guard|call_double, dfbb80=linear|call_subroutine|call_double, a66e24=linear|goto_dispatch|call_double, while d8acd3=cross_language|if_guard|percent and 0292c4/398c3e=...|delayed. So expansion has (at least) 3 values: percent (%v%), delayed (!v! under setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion), call_double (CALL-forced second pass, e.g. call set/echo %%v%%). Detect it from the bytes per file; keep percent where it is genuinely percent (the last rejected generalize broke variant-time_trial-b10c4da4 by over-applying). Mastery e24c070d has 12 batch-style misses of this kind + 6 python-*-handoff-id misses (solver gave PSPY-D4F3AA323D584FBF for set2/3/4 python-4c1097 -- likely a decoy/first-match id; re-derive).
